title: Multi-Subscription Cloud Pooling, Failover Routing & Skill Readiness Probe
hypothesis: A native multi-CLI fallback chain or lightweight proxy probe in cli-agent can automatically rotate between paid subscriptions (Claude Pro -> Gemini Pro -> ChatGPT Plus) upon rate limiting without running local M1 models, and pre-flight verify routing readiness before task dispatch.
falsification_criteria: CLI fails to rotate upon 429 rate limit, attempts to execute slow local LLM inference on M1, violates Copilot work boundary, or lacks pre-flight routing check.

evidence.details: Implemented check_routing_readiness.py and multi-backend fallback chain in run_agent.py (--fallback-chain agy,codex). Verified zero-daemon rotation, 429 rate-limit regex detection, and strict --allow-copilot boundary with 71 passing unit tests.

lessons_learned: Commercial consumer OAuth subscriptions cannot be pooled via local HTTP reverse proxy servers without raw API keys.
Direct CLI process failover (claude -> codex -> agy) provides zero-daemon, zero-RAM pooling without violating provider terms of service.
Copilot must be strictly excluded from personal research via opt-in --allow-copilot flag to maintain corporate-personal boundary integrity.

related_missions.MISSION-035: EXTENDS: 002's readiness probe and failover chain know which CLIs are installed and logged in; 035 adds measured 5-hour/weekly window state and per-task token deltas so failover and assignment can use real headroom instead of installed-or-not.
